phases.title: Baseline and safe test setup
phases.gate: Reproducible checks, isolated test data and recovery evidence are recorded.

phases.title: Project identity and access
phases.gate: Two projects and two accounts remain isolated through open, save and account switching.

phases.title: One real page document
phases.gate: Canvas, Pages, Layers and Preview render the same saved document; no sample content masquerades as customer work.

phases.title: Saving history and recovery
phases.gate: Save/reload, Undo, offline recovery, conflicts and restore work without false saved states.

phases.title: AI gateway and truthful status
phases.gate: Every provider attempt is metered and unavailable AI never reports ready.

phases.title: Calm workspace and direct editing
phases.gate: Approved default stays uncluttered; selecting, typing and dragging work with Undo.

phases.title: Responsive preview and publishing
phases.gate: A saved revision previews, publishes and rolls back with verified domains in the selected test hosting model.

phases.title: Sections assets and brand kit
phases.gate: Reusable sections, asset controls and shared brand styles persist across pages.

phases.title: Dedicated Content view
phases.gate: Page content can be drafted, reviewed and applied without silently overwriting unrelated work.

phases.title: Assisted prompts and Skills
phases.gate: Guided answers create an editable plan; scoped AI changes can be accepted, rejected and undone.

phases.title: Contextual Ask Forge help
phases.gate: Selected-element help explains cards, widgets and effects; explanations do not mutate the page.

phases.title: Effects preview library
phases.gate: Effects can be previewed, replayed and removed; reduced-motion behaviour is verified.

phases.title: Visual Site Map
phases.gate: Nodes and links reflect actual pages and link records; broken and isolated pages are identified.

phases.title: Advanced code and feature access
phases.gate: Manual code is preserved, validated and recoverable; paid feature access is enforced by the server.

phases.title: Mix and match billing and Usage
phases.gate: Bundles and custom plans share prices and entitlements; caps, top-ups, renewal and cancellation pass sandbox tests.

phases.title: Full UAT and release readiness
phases.gate: Critical checks, tenant isolation, billing, mobile UAT, backup restore and rollback evidence pass on the release commit.
